findings.title: `float: right` on the button has no effect now that `.small-action` is a flex container
findings.body: `.small-action` becomes a flex container, so its children are flex items and `float` is ignored on them. `.small-action button { float: right }` is still there, but the button is now laid out right after `.small-action-desc` instead of at the right edge. Within the same hunk, `.topic-avatar { float: left }` is also dead. The button needs `margin-left: auto` (or `.small-action-desc` needs `flex: 1`) to keep its old position. As written, the action button on small-action rows (for example the undo or delete button) shifts position.

findings.title: `align-items` mixin applies one value to legacy properties that expect different keywords, and includes a non-existent property
findings.body: The value is passed unchanged to `-webkit-box-align` and `-ms-flex-align`. Those legacy properties accept `start`/`end`, not `flex-start`/`flex-end`, so `@include align-items(flex-start)` would emit invalid declarations for old engines. `-ms-align-items` is not a real property and is dead output. The mixin emits `-webkit-box-align` but no `-moz-box-align`, although `flexbox()` and `order()` emit `-moz-box` and `-moz-box-ordinal-group`. Old Firefox would therefore get a `-moz-box` container with no vertical centering. The line at 120 also has trailing whitespace. Current callers only pass `center` and `baseline`, so this is latent, but the mixin is a shared foundation helper.

findings.title: `order(2)` on `.extra-info-wrapper` is a global rule that only works inside the header's flex container
findings.body: `@include order(2)` is added to the global `.extra-info-wrapper` selector, while the flex container that makes it meaningful (`.d-header .contents`) and the `.panel` ordering (`order(3)`) live in header.scss. The header layout now depends on two files staying in sync. Any other place that renders `.extra-info-wrapper` outside that flex container, such as a mobile or desktop override, silently gets a no-op rule. The same change also drops the `&.bullet { margin-top: 5px }` offset and adds `line-height: 1.5`. Bullet-badge alignment in the topic title now depends on `align-items: center` and the new inline-flex bullet rather than an explicit margin, and nothing verifies it.

findings.title: PR title and description do not match the change; no verification of the layout switch
findings.body: The PR is titled "Optimize header layout performance" and the description is just "Test 5". The change replaces floats with flexbox in the header and also rewrites `.small-action` layout, the topic title badge margins and the bullet badge display. None of this is a performance optimization and nothing in the PR shows a measurement. There is no explanation or visual check for the layout-affecting changes, such as removing `.title { float: left }` and `.panel { float: right }`. Reviewers cannot tell the intended scope, and the unrelated `.small-action` regression went unnoticed.
